title: Prove rank-six A3 shortening and exclude a P112 profile
body:
## Summary

Exclude the actual historical P112 TWOSIDE `(6,3)` profile `2,6^5,7^3` over every characteristic-zero field.

```text
2,6^5,7^3 with at least six code dimensions
  delete three unrestricted pieces
2,6^5 with at least three code dimensions
  choose two small pieces, common support at most 22
four binary-rank-six endpoints
  support count forces 80 incidences
  forced binary spans allow at most 64
contradiction
```

The new A3 shortening theorem uses the endpoints' binary rank to rule out the support-only equality case. Source, proof, exact receipt, controls and reproduction instructions are in `research/p112-a3-rank-six-shortening/`.

This takes the released deletion handoff in [Discussion3156](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19002333). Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`, Nick Petalas/PR3211 at `66ce40a4bf1c82a0e8b6e94067dc0ab2fbb4c008`, and the retained root-simplex/E8/P112 lineage. Baseline is canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. Development used substantial automated assistance.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the complete support-only A3 relaxation gives `136-12-2*22=80`, exactly the endpoint allowance. It does not exclude this profile.
- **After:** all 2,025 orthogonal frames and all 240 extremal endpoint cases pass exact checks. Each forced sixteen-coordinate set spans six binary dimensions and has no other live point in its span. Independent frame traversal, root-lattice labels and Gaussian binary-span checks agree.
- All 12 behavioral groups, registered CPython3.12 replay, warnings-as-errors, optimized CPython3.13 replay, read-only Git-free export, source pins and all 14 committed-byte comparisons pass locally. Two separate read-only internal reviews found no mathematical or correctness blocker; a test capacity guard identified in review was moved before allocation and rechecked.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-a3-rank-six-shortening
```

No full C5, `C(P112)>=64`, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. The original reduction and standard Weyl-chamber theorem remain dependencies. No independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed; hosted CI is separate. Open next questions are in the package README/TASK.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Only a new opt-in research package is added. Shared code, selected records and frozen inputs are unchanged.
